indicator_name: Upper income bound of each decile, annual
description: Верхние границы децильных групп по среднедушевому денежному доходу, годовые
methodology: Upper end of each decile's income interval (D01-D09 are the decile cut-offs; D10 is the highest income observed in the sample). Annual editions, 2022 onward. Editions read: 37365 2022, 179025 2023, 341348 2024, 341349 2025.
